personalised_fitness_coaching_framework.scope_rule: Fitness content is educational and does not diagnose, treat or replace medical advice. Pain, surgery, pregnancy, chronic disease and eating-disorder topics require qualified professional review.

personalised_fitness_coaching_framework.nutrition_rule: Describe food tracking and nutrition guidance as individualized support within the coach's verified qualifications. Do not prescribe medical diets.
